original_problem.statement: The broad Huneke-Wiegand conjecture is false.
original_problem.priority: Son Pham retains priority for the first public numerical-semigroup counterexample; Christensen, Gerko, and Iyengar give an independent field-extension construction.
original_problem.prohibited_reframing: No CAOS extension, replication, or presentation theorem may be described as solving or redisproving the original conjecture.

mission: Classify and explain counterexample mechanisms, prove family-level structural theorems, and publish only results that pass exact validation, a current primary-source overlap check, and a theorem-sized value gate.

focuses.title: Independent validation of the public counterexample
focuses.target: Reproduce the decisive colon and tensor-torsion certificate independently.
focuses.value: Establish a trusted baseline without claiming discovery priority.
focuses.success_gate: Two independent exact routes and an adversarial positive control.
stop_conditions: The public certificate fails exact reconstruction.
The work reduces to a duplicate of upstream code.
focuses.manuscript_route: frobenius-minimality as provenance and baseline only

focuses.title: Minimality, minimum-layer uniqueness, and an infinite counterexample family
focuses.target: Determine the least Frobenius value, classify its normalized minimizer, and replace the isolated example by an explicit infinite family.
focuses.value: Directly strengthens the public counterexample inside the same semigroup and ideal class.
focuses.success_gate: Certified minimality, complete minimum-layer classification, and an all-parameter family theorem.
stop_conditions: Primary literature already proves the same three results.
focuses.novelty_status: No exact overlap was found in the recorded primary-source searches; external expert confirmation remains pending.
focuses.manuscript_route: focused future submission A; immutable consolidated source is frobenius-minimality v0.25
focuses.first_bounded_action: Completed by EXP-004, EXP-005, EXP-007, and EXP-009.

focuses.title: Conductor, tangent-cone, and special-fiber algebra
focuses.target: Determine the conductor, reduction sequence, tangent cone, local cohomology, special fiber, and defining equations uniformly across the family.
focuses.value: Gives a coherent commutative-algebra anatomy of a new explicit family, but is secondary to counterexample classification.
focuses.success_gate: All-parameter structural formulas with exact proofs and independent checks.
stop_conditions: The results cease to share the conductor-algebra question.
focuses.novelty_status: Family-specific formulas appear absent from the searched sources; external novelty confirmation remains pending.
focuses.manuscript_route: focused future submission B; immutable consolidated source is frobenius-minimality v0.25

focuses.title: Curvilinear fiber-cone geometry
focuses.target: Identify the primary, curvilinear, differential, and Groebner geometry of the conductor fiber cones.
focuses.value: A coherent focused geometric result with an audience distinct from the counterexample-classification paper.
focuses.success_gate: Primary decomposition, sharp nilpotence, curvilinear model, differential signature, and complete reduced Groebner basis.
stop_conditions: The description is only computational at bounded parameters.
focuses.novelty_status: Internally proved and primary-source scoped; external expert confirmation remains pending.

focuses.title: Betti and syzygy anatomy of the special fiber
focuses.target: Complete a mathematically coherent part of the graded resolution rather than accumulating isolated Betti entries.
focuses.value: Potentially useful homological algebra, but increasingly remote from the original counterexample question.
focuses.success_gate: A complete row, strand, resolution, or reusable integral matching theorem.
stop_conditions: A result is one finite cell without a uniform theorem.
Three rounds fail to improve a complete-row or complete-resolution gate.
focuses.novelty_status: Several uniform rows are internally proved; their broader significance and external novelty need specialist review.
focuses.manuscript_route: focused future submission C; immutable consolidated source is frobenius-minimality v0.25
focuses.first_bounded_action: No new experiment. First obtain an external significance review of EXP-027 through EXP-036.

focuses.title: Canonical integral torsion and carrier quotient
focuses.target: Identify the semantic projection canonically with the persistent carrier and determine the complete projected kernel or 2-primary quotient.
focuses.value: Would turn the current presentation-specific lower bound into a structural classification; endpoint formulas alone are insufficient.
focuses.success_gate: A uniform comparison map plus either a complete kernel theorem, a complete 2-primary quotient, or a reusable finite-state integral Morse theorem.
stop_conditions: The next result is another bounded-parameter carrier table.
The comparison remains projection-dependent after one bounded theorem attempt.
No full upper bound or canonical map is obtained.
focuses.novelty_status: The direct-summand and endpoint-source theorems are internally proved; no exact overlap was found in the recorded source review, but peer validation is absent.
focuses.manuscript_route: integral-connecting-annihilators; no further version without the success gate
focuses.first_bounded_action: Write a theorem preflight for the canonical comparison map before declaring EXP-067.

focuses.title: Counterexample-mechanism classification in Kunz coordinates
focuses.target: Determine whether the CAOS infinite family lies in a positive-dimensional Kunz face on which the two-generated rigidity identity is characterized by explicit linear and sumset conditions.
focuses.value: Returns the program to the central counterexample mechanism and could classify families rather than continue presentation-specific invariants.
focuses.success_gate: A necessary-and-sufficient face criterion, a maximal stable face theorem, or a proof that no nontrivial stable face contains the family under the declared block model.
stop_conditions: The primary-source sweep finds the classification already known.
Small exact cases show no stable face or no invariant stronger than re-enumeration.
The proposed criterion cannot be stated independently of the existing parameter formula.
focuses.novelty_status: Candidate new focus only. A source-complete preflight and expert relevance check are required before any novelty claim.
focuses.manuscript_route: new counterexample-mechanism manuscript only after the success gate; otherwise research record
focuses.first_bounded_action: Persist a source-complete Kunz-face preflight, then test the smallest distinguishing invariant on p=4 through p=8 before declaring an experiment.

manuscripts.split_action: Freeze as the immutable consolidated source. Prepare focused submission A for direct counterexample extensions, B for conductor algebra, and C for Betti and syzygy anatomy. Do not duplicate Zenodo publication until each focused paper has an independent coherent narrative and overlap statement.
Keep intact. Publish another version only for a canonical comparison, complete quotient, or reusable general theorem.
